name: real-time-desktop-agent
description: Local Windows desktop capture and automation tools exposed through MCP.
long_description: RTDA exposes a local MCP server for Windows desktop capture diagnostics, UI Automation inspection, action planning, risk classification, and dry-run desktop actions. It is designed for private local use with Claude Desktop and other MCP-compatible hosts.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Return RTDA server status and implemented phases.

tools.name: capture_monitors
tools.description: List monitors visible to the local Windows capture engine.

tools.name: capture_diagnostic
tools.description: Run a short local screen-capture diagnostic and return frame metrics.

tools.name: inspect_uia
tools.description: Read a bounded Windows UI Automation snapshot.

tools.name: plan_goal
tools.description: Build a small deterministic action plan from a user goal.

tools.name: classify_action
tools.description: Classify desktop action risk using the RTDA safety policy.

tools.name: dry_run_action
tools.description: Resolve and simulate a desktop action without executing it.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Return current persistent DesktopSession status and telemetry metrics.

tools.name: get_focused_window
tools.description: Retrieve current active window title and executable path.

tools.name: observe_state
tools.description: Capture full multi-modal UI perception snapshot (UIA + ROI diff + Active Window).

tools.name: desktop_find
tools.description: Search for matching UI elements by query string across current screen tree.

tools.name: run_task
tools.description: Execute an autonomous multi-step goal through DesktopSession loop with verification and recovery.

tools.name: execute_action
tools.description: Execute a single desktop action with optional dry-run mode.
